correctness.rationale: Verified Lemmas 1-3 and slope iteration: scaling conjugacy phi(z)=lambda*z with lambda^{d-1}c=1 gives Prep(g_c)={0}U lambda*mu_inf from classical Prep(z^d)={0}U mu_inf; torsion criterion lambda in mu_inf iff c in mu_inf gives exact intersection {0}U mu_inf vs {0} (plus infinity projectively); height identity h_g(z)=h(z/lambda) plus h(ab)<=h(a)+h(b) gives S(z)>=h(lambda)=h(c)/(d-1) for z!=0, Kronecker gives gap dichotomy; slope s_n=c^{e_n}, e_n=(d^n-1)/(d-1) gives Delta preperiodic iff c in mu_inf and density-iff via product description. Certificates are finite spot-checks only; proofs are deductive. Minor domain restriction z!=0 for height inequality noted, not a defect.
